build_encoder_decoder_segmentor: build an EncoderDecoder segmentor with a backbone and decode_head config for semantic segmentation
run_slide_inference: run slide inference on input images using a sliding window with configurable crop size and stride
run_whole_inference: run whole image inference to produce segmentation logits from a batch of input images
calculate_segmentation_loss: calculate segmentation losses by extracting features and forwarding through the decode head during training
predict_segmentation: predict semantic segmentation results from input images and return SegDataSample with pred_sem_seg and seg_logits
